decision.explanation: The question asks when 'Henry St John-Mildmay' became a Baronet. The source documents describe three distinct individuals with this name who held the title sequentially: the 3rd Baronet (succeeded in 1784 per D1S3), the 4th Baronet (succeeded on 11 Nov. 1808 per D2S4-D2S5), and the 5th Baronet (succeeded in 1848 per D3S3). Since the query does not specify a generation number and all three are valid instances of the named entity becoming a Baronet, all three dates are retained as distinct valid answers corresponding to different referents.
